command: kubectl get configmaps -n wiki-ad4e -o name; kubectl get deploy,sts,ds,job,cronjob,pods -n wiki-ad4e -o json | grep -oE '"(name|configMapRef|configMapKeyRef)"[^}]*' | head -100

kubectl get configmaps -n wiki-ad4e -o name; echo ---; kubectl get deploy,sts,ds,job,cronjob,pods -n wiki-ad4e -o json | jq -r '.items[] | .kind+"/"+.metadata.name+" "+([.. | objects | (.configMap?.name?, .configMapRef?.name?, .configMapKeyRef?.name?) | select(.)] | unique | join(","))'
kubectl get deploy,sts,ds,job,cronjob,pods -n wiki-ad4e -o json | grep -i -B1 -A1 configmap
kubectl get deploy,sts,ds,job,cronjob,pods -n wiki-ad4e -o json | grep -A8 '"configMap": {' | grep '"name"'; kubectl get deploy,sts,ds,job,cronjob,pods -n wiki-ad4e
kubectl delete configmap import-rules page-templates-2023 -n wiki-ad4e
